text:
sec-alerts: Detector: high-confidence secret in Vault transit payloads. Found wrapped blob in gs://backups/staging/2026-03-23/backup.crypt ; wrapping_key=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/transit/cryptoKeys/transit-wrap :warning:

marta: @jia @omar can you quick-triage? scanner flagged base64 block that looks like an AWS secret pair inside the wrapped blob.

jia: jumping in. Initial read: backup agent submitted plaintext archive to our staging bucket and we applied server-side wrap (transit-wrap). That means upstream process probably had secret in clear. Checking recent deploys for pipeline changes.

omar: if agent did plaintext->GCS then KMS-wrap, we need to assume exposure window until wrap. First steps: suspend the backup agent SA key, create new key-version for transit-wrap, and start rewrap for any restored artifacts.

marta: agreed. Quick containment steps: 
- suspend svc account keys used by staging-backup (omar)
- create new key version and mark as primary (omar)
- kick off rewrap job across affected prefix (jia+omar)
- update backup agent to client-side encrypt before upload (jia)
- increase audit retention for KMS decrypts and GCS object access for 120d (marta)

omar: running suspend now: sanitized command I used:
```
# revoke compromised key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable 0a1b2c3d --iam-account=svc-backup-staging@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Also applying a temporary IAM Deny on storage.objects.create for the partner org until we validate their pipeline.

jia: small gotcha: some downstream restore tasks expect the blob to be wrapped with the current version id. Rewrapping will change version metadata; we need to update restore tooling to accept new cipher format. I'll add a feature-flagged client-side encryption to the agent first to avoid race.

marta: Omar, what's ETA on key-version create + primary switch?

omar: creating new key version now. commands:
```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=transit-wrap --keyring=transit --location=us
# set primary via policy (or new default)
```
Should be quick. Rewrap job: I'll run a containerized job that reads each object, calls KMS to decrypt with old version (we retain) and re-encrypt with new primary. Estimate 3h for full prefix (throttled). Kickoff in 30m.

jia: PR to backup agent: add client-side AES256GCM envelope encryption and strip payloads from logs. Small PR up in 20m. We'll gate rollout until rewrap completes to avoid double-encryption conflicts.

\marta: legal-bot: please create an evidence hold for the affected GCS objects and gloss over retention rules.

legal-bot: Evidence hold created: case SEC-2026-031. Notifying partner ops via secure channel.

omar: note: while we rewrap, we should rotate any downstream credentials that may have referenced items inside the archive. I'll produce a CSV of service names that requested object access in the last 72h.

jia: found two CI runs in team-backups that logged full archive names with expanded metadata. I've copied redacted excerpts to gs://evidence/SEC-2026-031/ and removed the original logs. Keeping SHA256 hashes for verification.

marta: good. Post-incident items:
- add detector rule for "server-wrapped blobs containing high-entropy base64 when source IP != known agent"
- require client-side envelope encryption for all backup agents by policy within 30d
- add orchestration workflow to no-op restore requests during active rewrap to prevent stale decrypts

omar: I'll also add an alert if we see KMS Decrypts for transit-wrap from unfamiliar principals. Set threshold to 1 per hour during incident.

jia: scheduling a follow-up audit: check all repos that modified backup agent in last 14 days. I'll send a list by EOD.

\marta: owners and ETA: omar (SA key suspend + key-version create + deny binding) 1min; omar+jia (rewrap job + verify) 30m kickoff, 3h run; jia (agent PR to add client-side encryption + log redaction) 0m PR, rollout after rewrap; marta (audit forwarder + alerts + partner notif) h. legal-bot (evidence hold + partner notice) h.

omar: deny binding applied; writes from partner pipeline blocked at 12:07 UTC. Starting rewrap in 28m. Will post progress updates.

jia: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/backups/pull/412 (WIP). Contains AES-GCM envelope; tests added.

marta: thanks team. Keep updates here. Once rewrap completes we will rotate any IAM keys tied to artifacts and confirm no additional exposures. :white_check_mark:
